method: AI independent semantic review of exact returned unit FIDs within that claim's allowed original evidence scope; claim text resolves conjunction/antecedent interpretation, while source proof uses only that unit's selected passages. No sibling/cross-claim/claim-level citation-union borrowing; context-candidate joins and flags are not source entailment proof.
counting_rule: A claim is all-unit-complete only if every original declared unit is complete with its own returned selected source FIDs. Partial means some core support remains but a predicate, identity, purpose, condition, qualifier, or state is not covered; unsupported means selected sources supply no adequate core support. Structurally invalid responses would have no quality denominator.
comparison_type: two identical-condition checker repeats, not two RAG strategies or a teacher-generation quality comparison
